literal: Father to son doing good deed, in assembly being first to sit making.
translation: The greatest good a father can do for his son is to make him worthy of sitting at the forefront of the assembly.
modern: ஒரு தந்தை தன் மகனுக்குச் செய்யும் நன்மை, அவனை அறிஞர்கள் அவையில் முன்னணியில் இருக்கும்படி தகுதியுடையவனாக ஆக்குவதாகும்.
explanation: This couplet defines the primary duty of a father towards his child. The phrase 'அவையத்து முந்தி இருப்பச் செயல்' (making him sit first in the assembly) means equipping the son with enough knowledge and character to be respected among the wise. The word 'நன்றி' (good deed or benefit) highlights that this is the most valuable gift a parent can provide. Rather than merely leaving behind wealth, a father's true contribution is raising a child capable of leading and excelling in society.
